outcome: Mean fetal renal artery pulsatility index (PI)
Cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate testing
cohort: 50 pregnant women between 24+0 to 36+6 weeks of gestation (25 with isolated oligohydramnios and 25 healthy controls)
finding: Fetuses with isolated oligohydramnios had increased left Mod-MPI, potentially indicating mild cardiac diastolic dysfunction, but this was not associated with adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate testing was significantly higher in women with isolated oligohydramnios compared to the control group.
birth_weight: Lower in the isolated oligohydramnios group
